chapters.title: Start Here
chapters.subtitle: Pick a route. Past achievements count. No charter gate.

quests.title: Your Next Adventure
description: Choose an adventure, an invention, or a place you want to make. The milestone routes are open from the start; specialist orders and contracts unlock as you progress.
Lines between milestones suggest a route; earlier milestones do not block credit for things you have already done. Crew projects, contracts, and paid orders require their connected prerequisites.
Already ahead? Your team's existing advancements automatically earn milestone credit when a member with that achievement is online. Collect the rewards, then go straight to the unfinished challenges.

Milestone coins are personal rewards for each teammate. Contracts and supply orders give one shared reward set. Withdraw bank money into your inventory before buying. Your old rewards remain in the Previous Questbook group.
Respect claims and clearly mark public entrances. PvP and pranks require consent; stop when asked. Neutral players can skip faction rivalry, and shared projects never require opposing factions.

tasks.title: Choose something you actually want to do

quests.title: A Short Fight
description: New or under-equipped? Take a shield and a friend out for a short fight. Defeat three zombies and three skeletons.
This is an optional fresh-combat warm-up, not an entrance requirement for veterans. The book rewards can protect the armor you choose.

quests.title: The Enchanting Workshop
description: Visit an existing Enchanting Infuser and inspect it. A teammate's working workshop counts; do not craft a duplicate.
Use the bottles to start upgrading your own equipment. Looking at the block verifies workshop access, not a particular enchantment.

chapters.title: Go Somewhere Worth Going
chapters.subtitle: Discovery, photography, dangerous places, and reasons to bring a friend.

quests.title: Bring Back Proof
description: Load an Exposure camera with film and take a photograph. Try your base from below, a strange mob, or your crew before a raid.
Existing Exposure achievement counts. The reward supplies your next photographic trip and a basic spare backpack.

quests.title: On the Wall
description: Develop and print an Exposure photograph. Turn something that happened on the server into something people can revisit.
The printing achievement is checked automatically. Hang your favorite result somewhere public.

quests.title: The Door Below
description: Find and enter Iron's Catacombs. Pack a way home, collect magical materials, and remember where the route begins.
The existing Catacombs advancement counts; veterans can collect this credit without another trip.

quests.title: Beyond the Dragon
description: Enter an End gateway and open the route to the outer islands. Already done it? Your existing advancement counts.
Take someone who has not seen the outer End yet; this milestone does not require everyone to repeat the trip.

quests.title: An End Postcard
description: Take an Exposure photograph in the End. Aim for something worth showing: a bridge, an End city, or the group against the void.
Exposure verifies the dimension when the photograph is taken.

quests.title: The Sunken City
description: Use the Explorer's Compass to find a Sunken City. Scout a route, prepare for underwater travel, and locate the Leviathan encounter.
Discovery earns its own reward. Defeating the boss is a separate goal in the Boss Board.

quests.title: The Frosted Prison
description: Track down the Frosted Prison and scout the Maledictus encounter. Bring your best mobility and a retreat plan.
An existing discovery counts, so a veteran can go directly to the boss objective.

quests.title: Above the Clouds
description: Locate the Acropolis, the next destination for a well-equipped party. Plan an arrival that you can also use to leave.
The Acropolis discovery advancement counts automatically; the Scylla fight has its own reward.

quests.title: Into the Maze
description: Explore the Cult of Azazel maze. Mark your entrance and bring somebody who enjoys getting lost with you.
Existing maze exploration is recognized. Killing Azazel is not required for this discovery reward.

chapters.title: Boss Board
chapters.subtitle: Old wins count. Your next untouched boss is the real destination.

quests.title: Kraken
description: Take a boat or airship to the fight and make a plan for staying together.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Underworld Knight
description: A good next target for a newly equipped fighter. Learn the openings instead of trading every hit.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Infernal Dragon
description: A separate encounter from the Ender Dragon. Bring fire preparation and ranged options.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Sandworm
description: Turn a desert expedition into a proper boss hunt.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Ignis
description: Coordinate your opening and recovery windows. Your existing Ignis victory already earns this credit.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: The Harbinger
description: Take on the factory encounter. Spend the reward on the next improvement to your loadout.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Ancient Remnant
description: The desert raid continues inside the Cursed Pyramid. A previous win counts.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Ender Guardian
description: A destination beyond simply reaching the End. Existing victories count.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Netherite Monstrosity
description: A fresh heavyweight target for the group. Prepare the arena approach before starting the encounter.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: The Leviathan
description: Your sea expedition culminates here. Bring a loadout designed for the environment.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Maledictus
description: A new challenge for players who already cleared Ignis and the Harbinger.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Scylla
description: The Acropolis raid is a reason to finish that airship, test a spell build, and gather the crew.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Clawdian
description: Another untouched Cataclysm encounter. Use the in-game guide and Explorer's Compass to plan the expedition.
Your team’s existing victory advancement counts. Each teammate can claim this reward once. For paid Ignis and Leviathan rematches, visit Crew Contracts.

quests.title: Azazel's Relic
description: Follow the Cult of Azazel progression to its Manipulator Stick relic. Possessing the relic earns this milestone; a kill alone does not.
Previously earned the relic advancement? Your team can claim the reward once per teammate.

chapters.title: Build a Spell Loadout
chapters.subtitle: Make choices that change how you fight. Keep the faction you enjoy.

quests.title: A Real Spellbook
description: Equip a spellbook. At an Inscription Table, give yourself a damage option and a spell that helps you move, survive, or support someone.
The equipped-book advancement is the automatic check; the spell choices are yours. Existing equipment milestones count.

quests.title: Choose Your Spell
description: Unlock the Scroll Forge milestone, then use ink, paper, and a school focus to pursue a spell you actually want.
Already own the workshop achievement? Collect credit and continue. No duplicate workstation needed.

quests.title: Tune the Build
description: Unlock the Arcane Anvil milestone. Use it to combine scrolls or improve a chosen equipment piece.
The anvil milestone is checked automatically; this opens the specialist upgrades in the Quartermaster.

quests.title: Write Something Dangerous
description: Obtain Legendary Ink. Choose the spell you want before spending it.
Existing Legendary Ink advancement counts, including ink already used. This opens advanced spell supplies.

quests.title: Room for More
description: Reach the Dragonskin spellbook milestone. Try a loadout with movement, defense, and more than one way to deal damage.
Existing ownership advancement counts, so equipment you already earned is recognized without rebuilding it.

quests.title: Own the Night
description: Unlock Vampirism's Bat advancement. Use the mobility to scout a place worth visiting with your team.
This is the vampire branch. Hunters can leave it alone; no chapter-wide completion is required.

quests.title: Tools of the Hunt
description: Earn Hunter Technology by obtaining both the Basic Tech Crossbow and the Enhanced Tech Crossbow as a hunter. Previously earned credit counts.
This is the hunter branch. Vampires have their own milestones.

quests.title: Vampire Level 14
description: Reach vampire level 14 through the faction progression. This is a longer-term faction goal, not an opening chore.
Your existing level-14 advancement counts if you already earned it.

quests.title: Hunter Level 14
description: Reach hunter level 14. Continue beyond basic hunting equipment into the faction's later progression.
Continue your chosen role; no vampire conversion is required.

chapters.title: Machines That Change the Server
chapters.subtitle: Credit for the factory you already built; challenges beyond the Digital Miner.

quests.title: The Brass Workshop
description: Reach the Brass milestone. In this pack, brass is part of the bridge into Mekanism.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: Precision at Last
description: Reach the Precision Mechanism milestone. Existing work counts; these mechanisms are required for the pack's control circuits.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: Steam Power
description: Reach the Steam Engine milestone. An existing steam plant earns credit when a player with its advancement is online.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: Your Working Factory
description: Reach the Mekanism Factory milestone. No dismantling or recrafting your installed processing line.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: Automatic Extraction
description: Reach the Digital Miner milestone. Your existing miner counts. The next steps are useful infrastructure and new forms of automation.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: Feed the Plant
description: Reach the Gas-Burning Generator milestone. Build a supply chain that keeps the generator useful.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: Automate the Essentials
description: Obtain a Formulaic Assemblicator to earn Automated Crafting. Then choose something the group keeps running out of and set up its recipe.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: The Pocket Warehouse
description: Reach the Portable QIO Dashboard milestone. Make stored resources easier to use and share.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.
The Mending book helps preserve a favorite tool while you work on the storage network.

quests.title: Maximum Steam
description: Complete Create's maximum steam-engine challenge. Improve the existing plant rather than starting a second starter setup.
Already earned the advancement? Collect your reward; no need to repeat it.

quests.title: Blazing Power
description: Build or visit an Energizing Orb and produce a Blazing Crystal. This opens Powah as an alternative project.
Inspect the orb and carry the crystal for detection; neither item is consumed.

quests.title: Wire a Motor
description: Build a Power Grid electric motor and connect it to a small useful mechanism.
Inspect the placed motor to claim the equipment milestone. Electrical operation is a project goal, not something this block check can prove.

quests.title: A Crew Dashboard
description: Install an advanced ComputerCraft computer and a monitor for a shared machine, route board, or ship dashboard.
Inspect both installed blocks. What the program does is up to you; a working display is the useful part of this project.

chapters.title: Flight, Freight, and Arrival
chapters.subtitle: Build something people will actually ride.

quests.title: A Flight Workshop
description: Set up a Physics Assembler and Navigation Table. Inspect the installed blocks; existing installations count.
Use the components' in-game Ponder scenes to plan your first craft. This milestone verifies workshop access, not a finished airship.

quests.title: Lift and Thrust
description: Bring together a Hot Air Burner, a Propeller Bearing, and a Steering Wheel. Parts already owned count and are not consumed.
Build a compact prototype before enlarging it. The separate crew flight challenge is about the actual journey.

quests.title: All Aboard
description: Assemble a Create train and earn its native train advancement. Prior train building is credited.
Connect places that people visit. The rails are for expanding the route after the first vehicle works.

quests.title: A Useful Railway
description: Complete Create's Long Travel advancement with a train journey. Check the native advancement for its exact distance requirement.
A scenic or useful route is a better reason to travel than circling the same track.

quests.title: The First Ferry
description: Fly a working craft from a dock with a teammate aboard, travel at least 500 blocks, then land intact at a second landing place.
Crew-confirmed challenge: the passenger confirms the trip before you tick it. One completion per team; one shared reward.
First complete the flight-workshop and propulsion milestones. Keep the route available for another passenger, with clearly marked docks and permission to land.

tasks.title: Our crew completed the flight and landing

quests.title: Freight That Matters
description: Reach both Packager and Stock Ticker milestones. Use the system to move a useful supply between a workshop and a destination.
The advancement checks recognize existing logistics equipment. Delivery design is your next project, not an invisible extra requirement.

quests.title: Workshop Wings
description: Obtain the pack's White Feathered Wings using its custom industrial recipe. The required HDPE Elytra connects this project to Mekanism.
The wings are not consumed. Already have this exact item? Carry it briefly for detection; no recrafting needed.

quests.title: A Road Home
description: Use Via Romana to connect the world and earn its first road-charting advancement.
Link real destinations and leave a clear entrance at each end. Existing charting credit counts.

chapters.title: Make This Place Yours
chapters.subtitle: Food, photographs, markets, interiors, and shared stories.

quests.title: Dinner Together
description: Place a Farmer's Delight feast and invite the crew. The native feast-placement advancement is the automatic check.
Make the meal a reason to gather before or after an expedition. Vampires can bring something suitable for themselves.

quests.title: Crew and Companions
description: Earn Exposure's Family Portrait: use a camera on a stand to capture a player, a tamed cat, and a tamed wolf in the frame.
The real Exposure advancement verifies the photograph. You keep the picture.

quests.title: A Familiar Face
description: Befriend an MCA villager to earn the Friend advancement. Spend time on interactions and gifts rather than treating every villager as a vending machine.
Existing friendship credit counts. This does not require marriage or a particular roleplay choice.
Use the chairs to make a place to sit with the neighbors you have met.

quests.title: A Better Palette
description: Set up a Chipped Mason Table and Carpenter's Table. Inspect the placed workstations; a shared existing workshop counts.
Use them to choose a palette for a build you want to finish. The reward supplies a small project without rewarding a stone-mining grind.

quests.title: Open a Stall
description: Place and inspect a Numismatics Vendor. Stock a useful offer and set a price someone might pay.
The automatic check proves a vendor is installed; it does not claim a sale happened. Invite another player to test it.

quests.title: Your Create Shop
description: Earn Create's Table Cloth Shop advancement. Follow the in-game advancement and Ponder instructions for the actual shop interaction.
This opens a different trading route from Numismatics Vendors. Existing progress counts.

quests.title: Show the Journey
description: Install a Vista television and obtain a viewfinder. Capture something from the server you want other people to see.
The checks verify the equipment, not the contents of a recording. Make a small viewing area instead of leaving the screen in a chest.

quests.title: A Welcome Guest
description: Finish a guest space with a bed or coffin appropriate for the guest, storage, lighting, and a clearly marked entrance. Invite a player outside your usual building crew to try it.
Guest-confirmed challenge: tick this after the visit. One completion and one shared reward per team.

tasks.title: A guest visited and used the space

quests.title: The Testing Grounds
description: With permission to use the site, build a marked cannon or spell-testing range away from other people’s structures and claims. Demonstrate it for a willing spectator outside the firing area, then repair the target area.
Witness-confirmed challenge. Use Big Cannons, spellbooks, target blocks, or the training dummy; nobody has to be the target. One shared completion.

tasks.title: Our witness saw the demonstration and the range is usable

chapters.title: Crew Contracts
chapters.subtitle: Optional repeat jobs. No streaks and no login calendar.

quests.title: Catacombs Rematch
description: Once the Catacombs milestone unlocks this contract, defeat a Dead King. Kills while the contract is available count automatically; old kills do not.
One shared payment per team. After all rewards are collected, the contract can be repeated six hours later. There is no penalty for ignoring it.

quests.title: Burning Arena Rematch
description: Once the Ignis milestone unlocks this contract, defeat Ignis while the contract is available. Old kills do not count; no manual acceptance is needed.
One shared payment, once per six-hour cooldown after rewards are claimed. Bring someone who wants practice; no artificial daily streak.

quests.title: Deep Water Rematch
description: Defeat the Leviathan after unlocking this contract. This can fund the next group project.
One shared payment. Six-hour cooldown begins after all rewards are collected.

quests.title: Supply the Galley
description: After earning Dinner Together, submit eight Beef Stews and eight Vegetable Soups here. Submission consumes the meals; it does not put them in a shared chest.

One shared payment of 32 Spurs and 16 Bottles o’ Enchanting for equipment repairs or anvil work. Claim both rewards to start the six-hour cooldown. Cook an extra batch if you also want meals for the crew.

chapters.title: Spend It on Your Next Project
chapters.subtitle: Coins buy convenience and selected upgrades. Orders are one shared parcel.

quests.title: Field Supplies
description: Human travel supplies for a quick expedition. Vampires may prefer a spell or building order.
Price: 16 Spurs. Withdraw the requested denomination at your portable bank terminal, then submit it here. Coins are consumed only when you submit them.
One team purchase gives one shared parcel: coordinate who collects it. Claim every reward before buying again. Repeat cooldown: one minute.

quests.title: Build the Thing
description: A bulk delivery for a real project: 512 stone, 256 oak logs, glass, scaffolding, and lights.
Price: 32 Spurs. Withdraw the requested denomination at your portable bank terminal, then submit it here. Coins are consumed only when you submit them.
One team purchase gives one shared parcel: coordinate who collects it. Claim every reward before buying again. Repeat cooldown: one minute.
